monday.name: Shiva
forms: meditating yogi seated on a tiger skin on Mount Kailash
Nataraja dancing within a ring of flames
Dakshinamurti, the silent teacher seated beneath a banyan tree
standing Mahadeva holding the trishul with a blessing hand
with Parvati as Uma-Maheshvara
Ardhanarishvara, half Shiva and half Parvati
symbolic Shivling on its yoni base receiving a water or milk abhishek, without a human figure

monday.name: Parvati
forms: Gauri seated serenely with a raised blessing hand
Annapurna offering food with a ladle and bowl
seated beside Shiva as Uma
Gauri with child Ganesha on her lap
Parvati meditating in penance in the mountains
four-armed Parvati holding sacred objects

tuesday.name: Hanuman
forms: kneeling in devotion with folded palms
flying while carrying the Sanjeevani mountain
standing valiantly with the gada
seated in meditation
blessing devotees with a raised palm
opening his chest to reveal Rama and Sita in his heart
Panchamukhi five-faced form

tuesday.name: Kartikeya
forms: youthful Murugan standing with the vel
riding his peacock
Shanmukha with six faces and many arms
Dandayudhapani, the ascetic youth holding a staff
symbolic worship of the sacred vel, without a human figure

tuesday.name: Mangala
forms: four-armed Mangala standing
four-armed Mangala seated
Mangala riding his ram

wednesday.name: Ganesha
forms: seated Ganapati with a blessing hand
Bala Ganapati, the child form holding a modak
Nritya Ganapati dancing beneath a wish-fulfilling tree
Siddhivinayak seated with the trunk turned to his right
standing Ganapati offering blessings

wednesday.name: Krishna
forms: Venugopal standing gracefully while playing the flute
Bal Gopal, the child holding butter
child Krishna crawling beside butter pots
Govardhan Giridhari lifting the hill on his little finger
with Radha as Radha-Krishna
cowherd Krishna resting beside a cow

wednesday.name: Vitthal
forms: Vithoba standing on a brick with hands on hips
Vithoba and Rakhumai standing side by side, each on a brick

thursday.name: Vishnu
forms: four-armed Vishnu standing
Anantashayana reclining on the serpent Shesha upon the cosmic ocean
riding Garuda
seated with Lakshmi
symbolic Vishnupada sacred footprints with tulsi, without a human figure

thursday.name: Sai Baba of Shirdi
forms: seated on a stone with the right leg crossed over the left
seated beside the sacred dhuni fire
standing with a raised blessing hand
resting under the neem tree at Gurusthan
symbolic Sai paduka with flowers, without a human figure

thursday.name: Dattatreya
forms: three-headed six-armed Dattatreya standing
seated in meditation beneath the audumbar tree
one-headed two-armed ascetic form
symbolic Datta paduka beneath the audumbar tree, without a human figure

thursday.name: Brihaspati
forms: sage Brihaspati seated as teacher of the Devas
standing with a blessing hand
riding a white elephant
riding a chariot drawn by eight white horses

friday.name: Lakshmi
forms: seated on a pink lotus
standing on a lotus rising from water
Gaja Lakshmi bathed by two elephants
Dhana Lakshmi showering gold coins
Dhanya Lakshmi holding the harvest
seated with her owl
symbolic Lakshmi footprints entering over a rangoli, without a human figure

friday.name: Santoshi Maa
forms: four-armed Santoshi Maa seated on a lotus
standing on a lotus with a blessing hand
seated on a tiger
seated beside a cow

saturday.name: Shani Dev
forms: dark Shani seated with a blessing hand
Shani riding a crow
Shani riding a vulture
Shani on an iron chariot
symbolic self-manifested black stone of Shani Shingnapur under the open sky

saturday.name: Hanuman
forms: kneeling in devotion with folded palms
flying while carrying the Sanjeevani mountain
standing valiantly with the gada
seated in meditation
blessing devotees with a raised palm
opening his chest to reveal Rama and Sita in his heart
Panchamukhi five-faced form

saturday.name: Kali
forms: Dakshina Kali standing over the reclining Shiva
four-armed Kali with protection and boon-giving gestures
seated Kali as a protective mother
compassionate close devotion to a Kali murti in her shrine

sunday.name: Surya Dev
forms: Surya riding a one-wheeled chariot drawn by seven horses
standing on a blooming lotus holding two lotuses
seated with a radiant halo
symbolic radiant sun disc rising over water, without a human figure

sunday.name: Rama
forms: Kodanda Rama standing with his bow
Rama with Sita and Lakshmana
Rama Darbar enthroned with his family and Hanuman
Rama walking through the forest in exile
symbolic Rama paduka on a throne, without a human figure
